acceptance_criteria: Record is clearly marked FUTURE_ENHANCEMENT and not current implementation work.
Portfolio Capital Allocation is explicitly separated from Research Capital Allocation.
Future architecture follows Hypothesis to Validation to Paper Track Record to Capital Eligibility to Portfolio Allocation Recommendation to Human Approval to Manual Execution.

Design includes capital eligibility gates, sleeve and hypothesis validation thresholds, maximum allocation limits, drawdown limits, confidence-adjusted sizing, diversification constraints, correlation checks, live pilot limits, kill switch, manual approval, Oak Harvest compatibility, and explicit no-autonomous-IB-execution policy.
Research allocation recommendations cannot become capital allocation recommendations.
No IB connection, live trading automation, autonomous execution, broker execution, or safety-gate behavior is changed.
Aegis does not imply readiness for real brokerage capital until closed outcomes, validation samples, statistical sufficiency, and paper-trading proof exist.
